stop_stage: Section 2 pre-flight, before any ticker run was started

A_real_tradingagents_execution_enabled.evidence: comqutor_alpha/server_execution.py:87-88 is_real_tradingagents_enabled() reads COMQUTOR_REAL_TRADINGAGENTS_ENABLED via _parse_bool_env(..., default=False); env var is unset in the executing shell -> resolves to False (fail-closed by design, per inline comment at server_execution.py:80-84).

B_alpha_mapper_llm_classifier_enabled.evidence: comqutor_alpha/structure_engine/week2_llm.py:391-394 week2_llm_enabled() reads COMQUTOR_WEEK2_LLM_ENABLED via os.environ.get(...); env var is unset in the executing shell -> _enabled(None) = False. This is the exact same gate that produced the prior NVDA run's 794/794 llm_unavailable/fallback_reason=disabled outcome (alpha_mapper.py:362-363).

C_provider_credentials_available.evidence: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY are not set in the executing process environment. A .env file at repo root does contain ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and DEEPSEEK_API_KEY entries, but no load_dotenv()/dotenv call exists anywhere under comqutor_alpha/ (verified by repo-wide grep) -- .env is not read by any runtime path, so those keys are not actually available to a run process.

D_process_inherits_settings.evidence: Moot: since none of COMQUTOR_REAL_TRADINGAGENTS_ENABLED / COMQUTOR_WEEK2_LLM_ENABLED / provider API keys are set anywhere reachable by a freshly spawned process (not in shell env, not loaded from .env), there is nothing correct for a child process to inherit.

E_semantic_mapper_would_enter_disabled_f.evidence: Given B is False, alpha_mapper.py:362-363 would return {"outcome": "unavailable", "fallback_reason": "disabled"} for every claim on every ticker, reproducing the exact dangerous failure mode this task's Section 2 was written to prevent.

action_taken: STOP before any ticker run. Zero TradingAgents calls made. Zero Provider calls made. No production code, Alpha Mapper, B1/B2/B4, conflict taxonomy, or regression labels touched. No commit. No push.
required_operator_action_before_retry: Set COMQUTOR_REAL_TRADINGAGENTS_ENABLED=true in the operator's own shell (never in .env -- per prior session guidance, this gate must not be persisted to a file) for the process that will execute Step 4.
Set COMQUTOR_WEEK2_LLM_ENABLED=true (or the recognized truthy value) in that same shell/process.
Ensure a real Provider API key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or the configured provider's key) is exported into that same process environment -- not merely present in .env, since nothing currently loads .env.
Re-run this Step 4 task only after confirming, in that exact execution shell, that all three checks above resolve to True/present.
